articles.label: Learning
articles.title: ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity Study Guide
articles.summary: My structured CC notes covering security principles, continuity and recovery, access control, network security, and security operations.
articles.body:
After passing the ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity exam, I organized my notes and useful resources into a public study guide for other learners.

The repository covers all five CC domains: Security Principles; Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery and Incident Response; Access Controls; Network Security; and Security Operations.

These are independent study notes, not official ISC2 course material. Verify objectives against the current official exam outline before preparing for an exam.

articles.label: Learning
articles.title: eJPTv2 Practical Penetration Testing Notes
articles.summary: The personal reconnaissance, Linux, Windows, and web-exploitation reference notes I used to complete eJPTv2 in four hours with a 91% score.
articles.body:
A practical reference collection created during my eJPTv2 preparation. It includes information gathering, service enumeration, Linux and Windows techniques, web assessment, Metasploit workflows, file transfer, credential testing, and post-exploitation reminders.

I completed the eJPTv2 exam in four hours and achieved 91% using my own notes. I published the collection to help other learners build a repeatable testing workflow.

Use every command only in labs, CTFs, or systems where you have explicit authorization.

notes.label: WEB TESTING
notes.title: A better starting point than a payload list
notes.summary: Map the data flow, trust boundaries and side effects before reaching for the usual strings.
notes.body: A short note is not a small writeup. It should hold one useful idea with enough context to make it reusable.

notes.label: DFIR
notes.title: The importance of negative evidence
notes.summary: What should have been there? That question frequently narrows an investigation faster than what is.
notes.body: Absence can be a meaningful artifact when it is measured against a clear baseline.

notes.label: TOOLING
notes.title: Automate the repeatable, narrate the unusual
notes.summary: Scripts should save attention for the decision points that actually require an analyst.
notes.body: Automation is valuable when it makes expert judgment more visible, not when it hides it.
